title: Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback as Thermodynamic Entropy Minimisation: A Formal Isomorphism and Testable Predictions
abstract: RLHF is formally isomorphic to statistical-mechanical entropy minimisation. Reward maps to negative energy, policy to Boltzmann distribution, beta_KL to temperature, RLHF objective to negative Helmholtz free energy. Three falsifiable predictions: optimal temperature scaling, grokking as first-order phase transition, and universal alignment-capability bound.

foundational_identity.interpretation: Boltzmann distribution with energy -R(s,a) and temperature T = beta_KL

isomorphism_table.stat_mech: Thermal fluctuation over barrier Delta F

free_energy_derivation.equation: J = E[R] + beta_KL * H(pi) + beta_KL * E[ln pi_ref] = -F + const

predictions.title: Optimal temperature scales with task entropy
predictions.test: Train on tasks of varying entropy; plot reward vs beta_KL per task class
predictions.falsification: Optimal beta_KL independent of task entropy

predictions.title: Grokking latent period scales with entropy gap
predictions.test: Modular arithmetic datasets varying modulus p; measure H before/after grokking
predictions.falsification: r < 0.3 between predicted and observed stall periods

predictions.title: Universal alignment-capability bound
predictions.test: Train family varying beta_KL; plot A*C. Should show universal maximum.
predictions.falsification: Monotone increase of A*C beyond predicted bound on high-beta side

design_principles: Task-matched temperature: set beta_KL from H_task, not grid search
Annealed alignment: high T early (capability), low T late (alignment crystallisation)
Landscape architecture: Constitutional AI shapes Delta F barriers
Jailbreak resistance is exponential: modest Delta F increase -> exponential P(jailbreak) decrease
